name: MonotaRO Co., Ltd.
summary: MonotaRO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates an online MRO products store for factories in Japan and internationally. It offers safety protective equipment, work clothes, and safety shoes; logistics, storage, and packing supplies; tapes; safety, disaster prevention, and crime prevention products; safety signs; office supplies; office furniture/lighting/cleaning supplies; cutting tools and abrasives; measurement and surveying equipment; work tools/electric and pneumatic tools; sprays, oils, greases, and paints; adhesives and repair materials; welding supplies; and plumbing, plumbing members, pumps, pneumatics, hydraulic equipment, and hoses.
